method: built-in browser pane on the user's Mac, condensed in-page analyzer (2026-11-03)

typography.eyebrows: small uppercase tracked labels above headings (e.g. 'FESTIVE HIGHLIGHT', 'HOTELS & RESORTS')

navigation: header shows only 'Menu' + 'Reserve'; everything else lives in a full-screen overlay menu with a Back step
takeaways: Extreme restraint: under 700 words on the home page, few large images
Two-item header (Menu / Reserve) + overlay menu keeps the first screen calm
Eyebrow label + serif heading pairing for every section
Slow, soft transitions (0.35-0.6s) instead of bouncy motion
